parsed.title: Stale reference to absorbed skill in fix index
parsed.detail: The Notes column for issue #258 lists `plan-feature-scaffold` as one of the 'Three surviving skills after feature 61'. However, the SPEC.md for this unit explicitly states under 'Why' and 'Non-goals' that `plan-feature-scaffold` was absorbed into `unit-lane` by feature 61 and no longer exists as a skill. The index incorrectly implies the skill still exists and is being modified.

parsed.title: Unverified claim about prior commit validity
parsed.detail: The 'Planning evidence' table entry PE-003 claims the fix follows the same defect class as `review-change` commit `29b52c63`, but explicitly marks this as 'ASSUMPTION-UNVERIFIED' because `git cat-file -t 29b52c63` fails. The 'References' section at the bottom lists this commit as a reference without the unverified caveat, creating a contradiction between the evidence section (which admits it's invalid) and the references (which present it as a valid anchor).

parsed.title: Roadmap row 68 references fix/258 as absorbed gap
parsed.detail: Row 68 (`subagent-first-execution`) states: 'Absorbed gap (2026-10-18, observed on feat/36 and fix/258 after unit 73's per-phase hand-off contract): running `/unit-lane` bare... leaves the lane doing design+plan only... the topology change is the fix'. This implies fix/258 addresses a gap in `/unit-lane`'s execution topology. However, the SPEC.md for fix/258 defines the objective strictly as 'harden needs-input interactive contracts' (guarding blank inputs), not fixing execution topology or hand-off contracts. This is a mischaracterization of the unit's scope in the roadmap.
